verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users work with Adyen through their chosen LLM client, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. However, the evidence describes it only at the Adyen developer-platform level. Nothing shows which risk-management operations (risk profiles, rules, lists, case review, referrals) the server exposes, how an agent connects or authenticates, or that it works in practice. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage of Risk Management functions, connection/authentication setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
